testing_summary: Exercised bin/fm-backup-helm.sh condition, probe, handover, arm, and retire via the behavior test suite (11/11 pass) covering all required condition classifications (all_models <43200 true, >43200 false, exhausted_now true, unknown false, missing-Claude-provider error, Fable-exhausted/all_models-healthy false, Fable-exhausted/all_models-short true), probe ok/missing paths, handover fail-closed paths (mid-turn, failed probe, unsupported backend, missing FM_HOME, unknown lock), handover success paths (idle+lock→stow/exit/launch, released-lock→skip-slash/launch), and arm/retire lifecycle (register, duplicate refusal, failed-probe refusal, retire idempotent). Additionally verified live against real quota-axi (condition returns exit 1 correctly when Claude quota is stale/unknown) and real cursor-agent (probe returns status=ok for cursor-grok-4.6-high). No findings.
tested: bin/fm-test-run.sh tests/fm-backup-helm.test.sh (11 test assertions, all pass)
bin/fm-backup-helm.sh probe (live against real cursor-agent, status=ok)
bin/fm-backup-helm.sh condition (live against real quota-axi, exit=1 correct when stale/unknown)
bin/fm-backup-helm.sh condition --runway-seconds 100000 (live against real quota-axi, exit=1 correct)

scenarios.name: Trigger uses exact all_models scope, not best-scope: a Fable window at 0% must not fire the watch while all_models still has runway above 12h
scenarios.reason: Cannot selectively exhaust Fable in real quota-axi. Behavioral fake validates the exact-scope trigger requirement that is the core user intent constraint.

scenarios.name: Trigger classifies all_models runway correctly: sub-threshold fires, supra-threshold or equal does not, exhausted_now fires, unknown stays false (keeps polling), missing provider errors
scenarios.evidence: Tests: quota_true (40000s<43200)→0, quota_false (50000s>43200)→1, quota_exhausted→0, quota_unknown→1, quota_missing (no claude)→2, quota_at_threshold (43200=43200)→1. Live: real quota-axi (stale/unknown)→exit 1.
scenarios.reason: Exhausted_now and missing-provider paths are untested live because real Claude quota cannot be exhausted or removed in this worktree.

scenarios.name: Probe verifies cursor-grok-4.6-high is in the catalog and fails closed when absent
scenarios.evidence: Live: bin/fm-backup-helm.sh probe → probe=cursor-grok status=ok model=cursor-grok-4.6-high. Test: fake catalog without model → exit non-zero.

scenarios.name: Handover waits out a mid-turn Claude (never interrupts), then sends /stow -> /exit -> waits for free lock -> launches Cursor Grok with --trust --yolo without -p, never deletes lock file
scenarios.evidence: tests/fm-backup-helm.test.sh: busy-driver→mid-turn fail (no sends, no launch, lock intact). idle-driver→/stow recorded, /exit recorded, launch includes --trust --yolo --workspace cursor-grok-4.6-high, env vars cleared, no -p, lock preserved.
scenarios.reason: Requires real Claude pane in tmux/herdr backend, real Cursor, and real firstmate state directory.

scenarios.name: Handover skips /stow and /exit when lock is already free/stale, and fails closed on unknown lock status
scenarios.evidence: tests/fm-backup-helm.test.sh: released lock → skips slash commands, launches directly. unknown lock → fail closed, no sends, no launch.
scenarios.reason: Requires real lock file state. Behavioral fake validates both paths.

scenarios.name: Handover requires FM_HOME, refuses unsupported backends, re-probes Cursor Grok before any pane operation
scenarios.evidence: tests/fm-backup-helm.test.sh: unset FM_HOME→refused, --backend zellij→refused with 'tmux or herdr', missing catalog→probe fails before any pane send.
scenarios.reason: Requires real backend. Behavioral fake validates all guard conditions.

scenarios.name: Arm registers backup-helm-claude-runway when-watch, fails closed if Cursor Grok is absent, duplicate arm is refused, retire is idempotent
scenarios.evidence: tests/fm-backup-helm.test.sh: arm→spec written, source-id matches. missing catalog→arm fails, no spec. duplicate→refused. retire→spec removed, idempotent.
scenarios.reason: Requires real fm-procevent-when.sh and firstmate state directory.

scenarios.name: Stock percent-threshold quota watch is not revived: script uses when adapter, not quota adapter, and explicitly warns against it
scenarios.evidence: Code audit: bin/fm-backup-helm.sh and docs/backup-helm.md never call fm-procevent-quota.sh. Docs say: 'Do not arm bin/fm-procevent-quota.sh for this handover, and do not revive a retired percent-threshold Claude quota watch.'
scenarios.reason: Architectural invariant verified by reading code and docs, not a runtime-executable scenario.
